name: Setup
description: What a project needs to build and run, and what this computer needs, each with why: checked on any machine, after any update, and written out as a setup script.
agent: Reproducible setups: setup_check (is this computer ready, and the fix for each thing that is not), setup_detect (what the project's files say it needs), setup_record (record a need with its reason, including pins learned the hard way, for the project or for this computer). Check it when a build fails after an update or on a new machine.

intro.tagline: Remembers everything a project needs to run, and why.
intro.what: A project needs certain programs and settings to work: the right version of Node, Java 21 for the phone app, a special setting for ollama on this graphics card. This writes them all down with the reason for each, checks this computer has them, and can make a script that sets up a new computer.
helps: After an update breaks something, it shows what changed.
A new computer can be set up from the list, not from memory.
The hard-won fixes (like the ollama setting) are never forgotten.
intro.example: A build suddenly fails. You press "Check this computer" and it shows Java has been updated to a version the phone build cannot use, with the command that fixes it.
